description: For a list of holdings (tickers, CIKs or FIGIs), every ex-date, record date, payment date and effective date in one week, day by day. The week holding `day`, Monday to Sunday; this week by default. Ends with an iCalendar (webcal) subscription URL for those holdings, to give the user for their calendar app.

day.description: Any day in the week, YYYY-MM-DD (optional; today by default).

name: holdings_calendar
title: What affects my holdings this week
